# B"H — 08 — Final Handoff

## What this continuation is

Planning successor to `2026-09-28-1954-heichelos-social-total/`, built on its
00-reality.md + REMAINING_WORK.md (its NEXT_ACTION.md was empty). It folds in
two coordinator scope updates: (1) the /heichelos listing + navigation layer is
a FIRST-CLASS "AMAZING, not basic" track; (2) the user's palace metaphor —
"Like walking through a palace. But better." — is a first-class design
principle in 02, 03, and 05.

## Ready for execution workers

- 00-current-breakage.md — what is broken, incl. Phase 0 `bootIkarFirst`
- 01-runtime-contract-map.md — contracts that must not be violated
- 02-heichel-repair-plan.md — P0 boot fix + root + amazing listing layer
- 03-reader-repair-plan.md — auto-scroll contract + Scribe's Lens + scroll-room
- 04-social-repair-plan.md — composer de-dup + hub routes + living quarters
- 05-design-system-plan.md — tokens, motion, nav, palette, palace law
- 06-execution-plan.md — strict phase order P0→P6 + release procedure
- 07-browser-verification.md — real-browser spec for the parent to delegate

## Key risks to watch

- Tunnel control plane flaked during planning (HTTP 409 tunnel_not_alive and
  HTTP 502 on the route-refresh endpoint). Policy held: wait 15s, refresh,
  retry ≤4x. Treat recurrence as transient unless down > 5 min.
- No watcher on `node index`:8080 — workers MUST restart before verifying.
- Dirty shared worktree (dd77276a2) — release ONLY from a clean isolated
  worktree off fresh origin/main.

## Open questions for the coordinator / user

- DB has NO description field for ikar (or, presumably, series) — confirm the
  "elegant quiet, never fabricate" policy is the desired long-term stance vs.
  adding a description column.
- Featured paths + progress signals: which data source feeds them? (Plan
  assumes "where data exists"; needs a source-of-truth decision in P1.)
- `scripts/bhRelease.mjs` must be READ before the first `npm run bh`.

## File ownership

Only `geelooy/.ai-thoughts/2026-09-28-1725-total-ui-repair/` was written.
Nothing else in the repo was touched.
